cases.query: I have wireframes and requirements for a field-service product, but no repository yet. Choose suitable current web, mobile, data, and identity technologies, then create the initial codebase and package structure.

We're starting an API for museum collections; today there is only an empty repository and a list of endpoints. Set up the service, persistence, deployment plumbing, and the conventions future modules will follow.

Our deployed clinic portal needs configurable care pathways across scheduling, notifications, permissions, and reporting. The architecture is still open and the work will land as several dependent pull requests; help us settle the approach and deliver it.

In the existing job worker, expose the maximum retry delay as a configuration option and update its tests and operator guide. Nothing is broken, and the work is confined to that package and its documentation.
